subject: Add global Search, Starter Models and user-selectable visible areas to FA3 Control Center
boundaries: Search is read-only and does not become a new index/canonical authority.
Conversation search uses the FA3 Unified Journal conversation projection and must not treat systemd journald as conversation history.
Area visibility changes only local GUI visibility and cannot disable canonical profiles, providers, gates, roles or authorities.
Starter model actions create or invoke existing Model Manager acquisition requests and cannot bypass Model Artifact Security.
Reference starter model names are replaceable candidates, not canonical model identities.
